minimum: able to understand the profile language
familiar with renting or housing decisions in Dhaka
exclusions: author of the profile being judged
access to hidden system ranking or score outputs

property: frozen route time/distance to each destination
stored rent-assessment facts without WSM score

relevance_scale.label: not_relevant
relevance_scale.rule: Violates an expressed mandatory need or is clearly unsuitable overall.
relevance_scale.example: Exceeds a no-flexibility budget or misses a required bedroom/commute constraint.

relevance_scale.label: marginal
relevance_scale.rule: Technically possible but requires substantial compromises on important preferences.
relevance_scale.example: Meets mandatory needs but has poor access to high-priority destinations and few desired amenities.

relevance_scale.label: relevant
relevance_scale.rule: Suitable with acceptable compromises and no hidden mandatory violation.
relevance_scale.example: Meets housing needs and commute limits, with a moderate tradeoff in size or amenities.

relevance_scale.label: highly_relevant
relevance_scale.rule: Strongly satisfies the profile across its most important needs with only minor compromises.
relevance_scale.example: Meets mandatory requirements and provides strong access, affordability, space, and preferred features.

presentation.affordability: Show advertised rent against maximum budget. Show estimated travel and total monthly spend separately and label them estimates, not WSM Budget Suitability.
presentation.commute: Show frozen road-network time and distance for each destination plus the profile limit; do not show a location score.
presentation.randomization: Randomize property order independently per annotator and profile using recorded seeds.
presentation.independence: No discussion or shared labels until initial judgments are locked.

quality_control.training: Use a written guide and practice items with explanations; practice labels are excluded from the benchmark.
quality_control.exclusion: Apply prespecified quality rules at annotator-session level before agreement or consensus calculations; retain an audit record.
agreement: quadratic-weighted pairwise Cohen kappa when exactly two raters are compared
ordinal Krippendorff alpha as the primary multi-rater agreement measure

label_derivation.initial_label: Median of at least three valid independent ordinal ratings.
label_derivation.adjudication_trigger: Rating range of at least two levels, no stable median due to missing ratings, or a documented mandatory-rule disagreement.
label_derivation.adjudication: A blinded senior annotator reviews the profile, property, and written rationales without seeing system outputs; preserve original ratings and adjudicated decision.
label_derivation.missing_labels: Remain unjudged; never convert to relevance zero.

ethics: Obtain institutional approval where required, informed consent, data minimization, withdrawal procedures, access control, and a retention policy before collection.
